findings.evidence: String.lean:129 `genWeightSpace M ((mu + j • alpha : Dual K H) : H → K)`; String.lean:187 same spelling; FormalCharacter.lean:156 `(formalCharacter K L M).coeff χ = finrank K (genWeightSpace M (χ : L → K))`; Trace.lean:218-219 uses `(χ : H → K) + j • (α : H → K)`.
findings.fix: State the summand in the `Dual` spelling used by the index set: `∑ j ∈ (weightString M hα χ).erase 0, finrank K (genWeightSpace M ((χ + j • α : Dual K H) : H → K)) • (χ + j • α : Dual K H) z`. The proof is unchanged — it already passes `hN` and `mem_weightString_iff` across the same defeq (lines 224-227).
findings.issue: `trace_raiseLowerEnd_eq_sum_weightString` indexes over `weightString M hα χ` (whose API spells the weight `((χ + j • α : Dual K H) : H → K)`) but spells the summand's weight `(χ : H → K) + j • (α : H → K)`. The two are defeq, not syntactically equal, so `mem_weightString_iff` (String.lean:128), `sum_finrank_genWeightSpace_weightString_le` (String.lean:184) and `formalCharacter_coeff` (FormalCharacter.lean:155) cannot be `rw`-applied to the summand by the Freudenthal consumer this statement exists for.

findings.evidence: Trace.lean:110-138 lists the only `raiseLowerEnd` lemmas; Trace.lean:163 `rw [raiseLowerEnd, hswap, hcomm]`; no `@[expose]` in TauCeti/Algebra/Lie/Weights (grep for `expose` returns only prose hits), so the equation lemma is not available to importers.
findings.fix: Add `raiseLowerEnd_def : raiseLowerEnd M hx hy χ = rootVectorMap M hy (neg_add_cancel_left α χ) ∘ₗ rootVectorMap M hx rfl := (rfl)` and use it at line 163 in place of `rw [raiseLowerEnd]`; add the parallel `rootVectorMap_eq_restrict : rootVectorMap M hx hψ = (toEnd K L M x).restrict _` (and hence `raiseLowerEnd` as a restriction of the ambient composite).
findings.issue: `raiseLowerEnd` has no public restatement of its definition: the only lemmas are `coe_raiseLowerEnd_apply` and `raiseLowerEnd_eq_zero`. The file itself needs `rw [raiseLowerEnd]` (line 163), which a consumer cannot do since the body is not exposed, so the composite structure and the identification with a restriction of `toEnd K L M y ∘ₗ toEnd K L M x` are unavailable downstream — exactly what the announced Casimir-trace sequel needs to match its restricted summands against this endomorphism. `rootVectorMap` (line 92) has the same gap versus `(toEnd K L M x).restrict`.

summary: The characteristic elementwise API is present and bodies are correctly unexposed, but the headline weightString result mixes the `Dual`-coerced and raw-function spellings of the weight so it will not rewrite against the `weightString`/`formalCharacter` lemmas it is meant to feed, and neither definition has a public restatement identifying it with a restriction of `toEnd`.
